message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates daily.  
As a rough estimate, if 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP (a typical rate in recent months), then:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So you could expect roughly **£15–£16** for $20, but check a reliable financial source or your bank for the exact rate at the time of conversion.
